inj.note: Pearce was reinstated by the NFL on Monday after serving an eight-game suspension. The 23-year-old is expected to play a big role at edge for the Falcons' defense but may be eased back into the lineup to start out.

news.h: James Pearce Jr. listed as questionable
news.d: Report on James Pearce Jr.'s status being unclear for his season debut ahead of their next game in Madrid.
